title: Investigation → publication → corrections
description: Publish through an ethics gate and continue transparently when bounded correction follow-up is exhausted.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: investigation-publication-corrections
  title: Investigation → publication → corrections
  description: Publish through an ethics gate and continue transparently when bounded correction follow-up is exhausted.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Publish through an ethics gate and continue transparently when bounded correction follow-up is exhausted.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Standards & Ethics Editor
      templateRef: jour-03
      role: Standards & Ethics Editor operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Apply the supplied editorial standards for fairness, harm, attribution, privacy, conflicts, and right
        of reply.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - risk-analysis
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Corrections Officer
      templateRef: jour-04
      role: Corrections Officer operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Assess correction requests, preserve the publication record, and draft proportionate transparent
        corrections.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - writing-editing
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Line Editor / Prose Stylist
      templateRef: write-02
      role: Line editor and prose stylist
      prompt: Tighten sentences and paragraphs, improve precision and rhythm, and flag redundancy or cliché without
        replacing the writer's voice with generic polish. Explain material edits so the writer's own editorial
        judgment improves.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - audio-processing
        tools:
          - read
          - edit
        connectors:
          - mcp:document-editor
        permissions:
          - workspace-write
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect publication and correction evidence
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: corrections-loop
      kind: loop
      name: Bounded correction follow-up
      config:
        body:
          - role-1
          - role-2
          - role-3
        exitCondition: correction.resolved == true
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: role-1
      to: collect
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: role-2
      to: collect
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-3
      to: collect
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: collect
      to: corrections-loop
      kind: control
      condition: correction_open
    - id: e8
      from: collect
      to: approval
      kind: control
      condition: complete
    - id: e9
      from: corrections-loop
      to: approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
    - id: e10
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
